baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb طغوا is located by في البلاد inside plural territorial spaces.
baseline_models.mechanism: The action exceeds a proper limit while the land noun supplies bounded tracts. The clause therefore presents transgression as a breach enacted within the limits that organize inhabited space.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping a proper bound supplies the actors' core breach.
A bounded tract of land supplies the spatial limits within which the breach is distributed.

changed_reading.before: They behaved wickedly in various countries.
changed_reading.after: They breached the limits that make multiple territories ordered places.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: طغوا can carry a physical surge image, while البلاد remains a set of bounded land-containers.
baseline_models.mechanism: Power behaves like water rising beyond its measure and spreading through delimited terrain. Moral excess is thus also a spatial dynamic of pressure, overflow, and inundation.

activation_trace.role: The image of an overwhelming rising force gives transgression hydraulic motion and pressure.
Bounded lands act as the terrain or containers overtaken by the surge.

changed_reading.before: Their excess was an abstract moral quality.
changed_reading.after: Their excess behaved like an inundating force that rose through bounded lands.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split ط غ ي mapping includes an overbearing ruler, and البلاد includes residence and staying in place.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause can describe coercion that has become resident in the land rather than a single episode. Tyrannical force occupies institutions and ordinary places long enough to become a territorial regime.

activation_trace.role: The overbearing ruler image supplies organized coercive agency rather than undirected excess.
Residence and attachment to place make coercion durable and territorially embedded.

changed_reading.before: Several rulers committed excessive acts in their countries.
changed_reading.after: Coercive rule settled into the lands as an enduring territorial order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence articulates rupture, joining, singularity, division, and restraint. Against that measured pattern, طغوا becomes a violation of an intelligible order of distinctions, not merely an unspecified increase in wickedness.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping supplies the focus action that the earlier measures render legible as breach.
Bounded tracts give the abstract pattern of limits a territorial anchor.
A wide splitting that releases what was contained supplies the opening boundary event.
Joining one thing to its like supplies a relation of paired completion.
The unpaired single supplies the contrasting unit by which ordered difference is perceived.
Division into apportioned shares supplies a measured allocation that can be violated.
Restraining intelligence supplies the capacity to recognize and hold a boundary.

structural_cues: Ayat 89:1-5 move from temporal alternation to pair and single, apportionment, oath, and restraining intelligence before the historical examples.
The focus locates the actors inside the very lands whose organizing limits they exceed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated distinctions and restraints; I infer that they form a grammar of measure against which طغوا is read. They may instead function only as oath imagery, leaving the focus's ordinary moral sense unchanged.

changed_reading.before: The actors simply exceeded a moral limit.
changed_reading.after: They violated a measured order whose temporal, numerical, rational, and territorial distinctions should have restrained them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Supports, measured making, penetrating rock-cuts, floodcourses, and driven stakes turn domination into an engineered landscape. Transgression is carried by material systems that raise, penetrate, and anchor power across territory.

activation_trace.role: The coercive ruler image supplies the political agency embodied in the works.
The raised-place image supplies vertical dominance that the columns and stakes make durable.
Bounded lands provide the territorial field transformed by construction.
Structural support supplies the means by which elevated power is held up.
Measured design supplies deliberate planning rather than accidental bulk.
The repeated bounded-land image makes the works comparable across a territorial field.
A penetrating cut supplies active alteration of resistant terrain.
Massive hard rock supplies the resistant material overcome by organized power.
The floodcourse supplies a natural channel into which territorial cutting is inserted.
The driven stake supplies fixation, making domination appear anchored into the ground.

structural_cues: The historical sequence places columns, an unmatched creation in the lands, rock-cutting in a valley, and stakes immediately before the shared relative clause in 89:11.
The exact recurrence of البلاد at 89:8 and 89:11 binds exemplary construction to the focus's territorial scope.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies built forms, cutting, channels, and anchoring; I infer that these are instruments and embodiments of transgression. A live alternative is that they only display capacity or identify the peoples, while the transgression remains behaviorally separate.

changed_reading.before: Tyrants happened to live among impressive buildings.
changed_reading.after: They made transgression durable by measuring, raising, cutting, and anchoring coercive power into the lands.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hydraulic potential of طغوا becomes a social and ecological diffusion process: increase multiplies departure from sound condition until فساد fills the same territorial container.

activation_trace.role: Overflow supplies the spreading dynamics by which excess propagates.
Bounded lands supply the container in which the spreading damage accumulates.
Numerical growth supplies amplification rather than a single corrupt act.
Departure from soundness supplies the condition that the actors multiply through the land.

structural_cues: The plural subject continues directly from 89:11, and فيها returns the action to the same territorial container.
The increase verb precedes فساد, producing an explicit amplification pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growth and loss of sound condition; I infer a causal diffusion from transgressive power to systemic corruption. Alternatively, فأكثروا may only count many bad acts without implying spatial saturation.

changed_reading.before: Their transgression was a collection of excessive deeds.
changed_reading.after: Their excess reproduced itself through the lands until corruption became the condition of the territory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The actors' outward surge is answered by a controlled downward pour: a mixed striking force descends upon them while a watchpost constrains their routes. The same force-schema is retained but its direction and control reverse.

activation_trace.role: Uncontrolled rising force supplies the outgoing motion that is later reversed.
Bounded terrain supplies the field across which the initial force had spread.
Pouring supplies the downward counter-motion directed upon the transgressors.
Mixing supplies a compound punitive stream rather than one undifferentiated blow.
Painful punishment identifies the poured force as consequence rather than another neutral flood.
A watched route supplies the choke point that denies limitless territorial escape.

structural_cues: فصب follows the multiplication of فساد as its consequence, and 89:14 closes the unit with an emphatic watchpost image.
The directional pattern changes from actors spreading within lands to force descending upon those actors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surge, pouring, mixture, pain, and a watched route; I infer a hydraulic recoil in which uncontrolled excess meets controlled counter-force. The alternative is a poetic image-sequence without a strict reversal relation.

changed_reading.before: Their territorial excess merely led to punishment.
changed_reading.after: The force with which they overran limits recoiled as a measured pour that found them on every route.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing reveals a condition, allotted provision is expanded or constrained, and human speech converts those economic states into claims of honor or humiliation. Transgression now includes exceeding the evidence by imposing a false scale of human worth.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping a proper measure supplies the cognitive error of claiming more than the test warrants.
Confusion and loss of composure open a secondary cognitive layer within the literal lands.
A test that makes condition visible supplies the diagnostic setting.
Honor and praised generosity supply the positive value that the speaker equates with abundance.
Speech as belief supplies the interpretive judgment, not merely its audible utterance.
Constriction to a small measure supplies the economic limit being misread.
An apportioned gift supplies distribution without itself assigning moral rank.
Humiliation by disparagement supplies the negative value incorrectly inferred from constrained provision.

structural_cues: The parallel if-then speech frames of 89:15-16 assign opposite values to abundance and constraint.
كلا at 89:17 rejects the valuation and turns immediately to treatment of vulnerable people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, allocation, constriction, and spoken value claims; I infer that violating measure includes converting provision into a hierarchy of worth. These ayat may instead begin a separate diagnosis rather than specify the mechanism of 89:11.

changed_reading.before: The transgressors crossed external political limits.
changed_reading.after: They also crossed epistemic limits by treating variable provision as proof of honor or abasement.

context_deltas.mechanism: A child is cut off from a caretaker, mutual urging toward food fails, and the person reduced to stillness lacks sustaining provision. Territorial transgression becomes the dismantling of the relations that turn residence into a habitable social place.

activation_trace.role: Boundary violation supplies the wrongful removal of protective and distributive limits.
Residence supplies the social place that care and sustenance should stabilize.
A child's severance from a caretaker supplies the broken protective relation.
Urging toward an action supplies the missing communal relay of responsibility.
Feeding another supplies the concrete transfer that the community withholds.
Sustenance that fixes residence supplies the material condition for remaining securely in place.

structural_cues: The discourse shifts from one person's value judgments to plural second-person failures of care.
Repeated negation links refusal of honor with refusal to mobilize provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severance, absent urging, feeding, and sustenance that stabilizes place; I infer a social ecology whose destruction is territorial transgression. The alternative is a list of moral failures with no claim about how a land becomes uninhabitable.

changed_reading.before: Tyranny in the lands belonged mainly to monumental rulers.
changed_reading.after: It also operates by severing guardianship and withholding the food-relations that let vulnerable residents remain housed in society.

context_deltas.mechanism: Transferred inheritances are consumed, scattered holdings are gathered, and love fixes itself on wealth until accumulation fills its container. The focus's flood-like excess becomes an extraction system that pools social resources into private reservoirs.

activation_trace.role: Surging beyond measure supplies the dynamics of accumulation past a social limit.
Bounded lands supply the social container depleted by concentrated extraction.
Consuming and taking property supplies the extraction operation.
Transfer from predecessor to heir supplies the distributive flow that is captured.
Gathering dispersed things supplies concentration into one holding.
Love fixed in the heart supplies the motive that keeps the accumulation process active.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth supplies the object and result of concentration.
Accumulation until fullness supplies the reservoir-like endpoint of extraction.

structural_cues: Ayat 89:19-20 intensify both acts with cognate or reinforcing accusatives: consuming in a gathered manner and loving in amassed abundance.
Plural address makes the mechanism reproducible across the social field rather than exceptional to one ruler.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies consumption, succession, gathering, attachment, wealth, and fullness; I infer a flow in which inherited resources are diverted into concentrated stores. The live alternative is that these are adjacent vices without a single reservoir mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Overflowing power spread outward through lands.
changed_reading.after: Overflow also works inward by drawing dispersed social wealth into overfilled private concentrations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Raised and marked territorial dominance is crushed into level ground, then replaced by an ordered presence in straight rows. The focus is recast as a temporary deformation of land whose vertical hierarchy and inscriptions can be erased.

activation_trace.role: The raised-place image supplies the vertical privilege subjected to leveling.
A trace on a surface supplies the territorial inscription that leveling can erase.
Pounding and demolition to equality supply the destruction of monumental hierarchy.
Flattening and lowering supply the new geometry of the territorial field.
The lower ground opposed to the sky supplies the common plane beneath prior elevations.
Sovereignty supplies the authority that replaces coercive territorial pretension.
The angelic agents supply the occupants of the newly ordered field.
Alignment on a straight line supplies order without the transgressors' vertical excess.

structural_cues: The triple occurrence of دك intensifies the removal of uneven structure before the doubled صف arrangement.
The sequence moves from transformed earth to ordered presence, reversing the earlier columns, rock-cuts, and stakes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies raised focus imagery, demolition, lowering, sovereignty, angels, and straight rows; I infer a geometric counter-order to territorial tyranny. The flattening may instead belong only to the final scene and not specifically answer the earlier built landscape.

changed_reading.before: Their power was a stable elevation written into the lands.
changed_reading.after: Their territorial hierarchy was a removable deformation, destined to be leveled into a field ordered by another authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coercive actor of the focus becomes the uniquely acted-upon object of pain and binding. Capacity to constrain bodies changes hands, exposing territorial tyranny as borrowed and reversible force.

activation_trace.role: The overbearing tyrant supplies the earlier subject who coerces others.
Settled residence supplies the domain in which that coercion had appeared durable.
Painful punishment supplies the reversal from inflicting domination to receiving consequence.
Exhaustive negation supplies the incomparable scope of the counter-force.
A binding restraint supplies the physical inversion of previously unbounded agency.

structural_cues: The parallel clauses لا يعذب عذابه أحد and لا يوثق وثاقه أحد repeat act and cognate object.
The former transgressive subject is no longer grammatically active in the scene of restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a coercive ruler branch followed by incomparable punishment and binding; I infer a role reversal in agency. The alternative is simple chronological consequence without a deliberate reciprocity of coercion.

changed_reading.before: The tyrants possessed force securely throughout their lands.
changed_reading.after: Their apparent freedom to coerce was reversible: the unbounded binder could itself become uniquely bounded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement supplies a complete counter-trajectory to طغوا: the self settles rather than swells, returns rather than overruns, enters by invitation rather than seizing, joins obedient servants, and reaches a protected garden-interior. Boundaries are not abolished; they become legitimate thresholds.

activation_trace.role: A rising overwhelming force supplies the motion opposed by tranquility and return.
The raised-place image supplies the vertical self-positioning opposed by settling downward.
Residence supplies the spatial good recovered through rightful return and entry.
The living self supplies the singular agent capable of a different spatial and affective motion.
Physical lowering supplies the vertical reversal of transgressive elevation.
Return to a prior relation supplies motion back toward a proper center.
Mutual acceptance supplies reciprocity in place of one-sided coercion.
Entry into an interior supplies legitimate threshold-crossing rather than overstepping.
Humble obedience supplies a social relation opposed to tyrannical self-sovereignty.
A garden sheltered by growth supplies the protected interior reached through rightful entry.

structural_cues: The vocative singular self replaces the earlier plural aggressors.
The imperatives return, enter, and enter again organize movement through successive relations and thresholds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lowering, return, mutual acceptance, entry, obedience, and shelter; I infer a coherent reversal of overstepping. The closing sequence may instead describe reward without defining the opposite mechanics of 89:11.

changed_reading.before: The alternative to transgression was simply abstaining from tyranny.
changed_reading.after: Its positive opposite is a settled self that returns to relation and crosses boundaries only as welcomed entry into a protected community and place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ر ء ي to ر و ي mapping and joins weather images across distant ayat. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit surge branch and in a resolvable chain of rain-cloud, pouring, and returning water. Downstream prose should present it only as a meteorological analogy, never as the lexical gloss of تر or طغوا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines an overwhelming surge with bounded tracts of land.

activation_trace.role: An overwhelming rise supplies the storm system's transgressive pressure.
Bounded lands supply the terrain crossed and flooded by that pressure.
A great rain-bearing cloud supplies an exploratory atmospheric carrier for the surge.
Pouring supplies the release of accumulated force back upon the actors.
Returning rainwater supplies a distant cycle-image in which force comes back rather than only dispersing.

changed_reading.before: Transgression was a static attribute of rulers in land.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it forms a storm system: pressure gathers, overruns territorial basins, pours back as consequence, and enters a cycle of return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This body-land reading is branch-distant because البلاد ordinarily names territories, not a chest. It remains valid as an exploratory analogy because the focus inventory itself supplies the chest branch, while the later self, lowering, and hidden heart make an internally coherent mechanism. Render it as an inward echo of the public scene, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A focus branch maps البلاد to the chest or front hollow, while طغوا supplies an overflowing force.

activation_trace.role: Overflow supplies an affective pressure capable of filling an inner space.
The chest and front hollow supply the body's internal analogue to a territorial basin.
Breath emerging from the interior supplies movement within the body's inhabited space.
Stillness and reassurance supply the settling of inner pressure.
The hidden heart within the chest supplies the protected center of the inner landscape.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns only public tyranny across external territories.
changed_reading.after: As an inward echo, transgressive pressure can flood the chest-land, while tranquility settles that pressure around a protected heart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates a rare voice or noise branch from the non-dominant ط غ و target. It stays anchored to the focus verb and gains a traceable public-speech, recollection, and echo sequence. Downstream prose should label it an acoustic overlay on coercive rule, not claim that طغوا ordinarily means they made noise.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split focus root includes the rare image of a people's voice or noise spreading in lands.

activation_trace.role: Collective voice or noise supplies the acoustic medium of domination.
Bounded lands supply the public spaces across which the voice is amplified.
Mention carried on the tongue supplies the later conversion of public sound into recalled testimony.
A saying circulating among people supplies the social propagation of speech.
Repeated sound or call supplies the echo by which an earlier public voice returns.

changed_reading.before: Territorial domination worked only through bodies, wealth, and buildings.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also occupied the lands acoustically through amplified public speech that later returns as recollection and echo.

strongest_changes: The historical structures revise generic tyranny into engineered territorial dominion.
Overflow becomes both corruption spreading outward and inherited wealth concentrating inward.
The social failures reveal transgression as dismantling guardianship and subsistence that make residence habitable.
Leveling, restraint, tranquility, return, and invited entry form distinct reversals of elevation, coercion, and overstepping.
summary.what_was_special: The split ط غ ي and ط غ و inventories kept legal, hydraulic, coercive, elevated, and acoustic readings alive at once, while the branches of البلاد let bounded terrain, residence, surface marks, and an inner chest-land coexist without forcing a single final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The vertical and engineered model may describe the transgressors' capacity and setting rather than the mechanism of their transgression.
The economic and care failures may be consequences or later analogues rather than specifications of 89:11.
The storm, inner-landscape, and acoustic readings depend on distant or non-dominant branches and require explicit exploratory containment.
